items: A customer data platform stitches records from your POS, online ordering, reservations, reviews, email, SMS and social into one profile per guest, matched across all your locations.
Unlike a raw database, a CDP gives marketing and operations teams a usable interface, so you can segment guests by frequency, spend, recency and lifetime value without writing queries.
Use those profiles to spot at-risk and lapsed guests early and trigger win-back campaigns, then track retention and campaign results by location.
Momos builds a single profile for each guest, ties satisfaction signals such as NPS, CSAT and sentiment to it, and powers targeted email and SMS marketing from the same data.
